data.name: Ratdoodle Adventure
data.detailed_description:
Explore an adorable Claymation inspired world as Doodle the Rat in this whimsical 3D Platforming Adventure! 

After crash landing on an alien planet, Doodle finds that its inhabitants may need even more help than he does! A flood of strange machines has recently begun to take hold of the local wildlife, causing the otherwise docile creatures to attack anything and everything around them!

Use Doodle's Glitter Ability to float in the air, or launch around the stage with a targeted boost mechanic. Perform good deeds-- like saving friendly critters from danger, restoring ancient temples, and freeing the wildlife from the mind controlling devices called Erasers-- to produce and collect an energy source called Glitter Sparks. Use the Glitter Sparks you collect to open paths to new parts of the island, and stop the evil tyrant Erase's plans for world domination before it’s too late!

Weebie Oasis

Throughout your adventure, you’re likely to come across mysterious colorful eggs known as Weebie Orbs. When you do, be sure to pick them up and bring them back to the Weebie Oasis: a mysterious meadow at the back of Swan Island where you can hatch Weebie Orbs into full-grown Weebies! Then, customize them with different colors and outfits you earn during your journey. Spend your downtime with your new adorable friends, and make the Oasis your own!

Time Trials

Once you’ve completed a level, you can re-enter to find a timer has appeared, as well as a ghost that follows your last path through the level. Depending on how quick you are, you’ll earn medals that prove to everyone just how good you really are. Push yourself to the limit and find out how fast you can go!

data.short_description: Jump, soar, and slide as Doodle the Rat through a claymation-inspired 3D platformer adventure! Will you be able to chain together Doodle's unique abilities to stop the tyrant Erase and bring peace to the alien world of Swan Island?
